chapters.title: A region prepares
chapters.text: Word reaches the regional office that people displaced from their homes will be arriving over the coming seasons. Nobody there has all the answers, but they agree on one thing: the newcomers are people with skills, families and plans of their own, and the region's job is to be ready for them.

chapters.title: The first commitment
chapters.text: The region makes its first real commitment of resources. It is only a start, but it turns a good intention into something a family can actually use when they arrive.

chapters.title: Three kinds of readiness
chapters.text: Housing, integration services and infrastructure are all in place now. A roof, a caseworker and a working road each help on their own, and much more so together.

chapters.title: The people behind the services
chapters.text: After repeated investment, the integration services have become dependable: language classes, help with paperwork, someone to call when a form makes no sense. Newcomers say it is the first place where anyone has explained things clearly and unhurriedly.

chapters.title: The hundredth arrival
chapters.text: More than a hundred people have now come to the region, each with their own story of why they left and what they hope for. The office keeps the records carefully, because behind each line in the register is a person.

chapters.title: Room to grow
chapters.text: The region's combined capacity now stands well beyond where it started. It came from many small decisions, made season after season, to build for the people who would come next as well as those already here.

chapters.title: Steady through the first year
chapters.text: The region reaches its twenty-first round without strain ever crossing into critical. It took planning ahead of need, and a willingness to spend on capacity before the pressure showed.

chapters.title: Back from the edge
chapters.text: The region was under real strain, with services stretched thin and staff worn out. Extra support arrived, priorities were reset, and slowly things came back to stable. Recovery is possible, and it is easier when the region asks for help early.

chapters.title: The turning point
chapters.text: The region reaches the point where investing in integration begins to pay for itself. Newcomers who were once supported are now working, paying into the community, and supporting others in turn.

chapters.title: Earlier than expected
chapters.text: The turning point arrives well ahead of the schedule the planners had penciled in. Early, steady investment in services made it possible, and the office notes it down as a lesson worth repeating.

chapters.title: A hundred neighbours
chapters.text: A hundred people are now fully part of the region: enrolled, employed, known by name at the market. Integration is not a single event, and for each of them it has been a long stretch of small steps that eventually added up.

chapters.title: The waiting list empties
chapters.text: The backlog of people waiting for integration support has been cleared. It was a long queue, and every person on it was waiting for something they needed, so seeing it finally gone means a great deal to the staff.

chapters.title: A balanced region
chapters.text: Services, the local economy and social cohesion have all reached a healthy level at the same time. Improving one can leave the others behind, so keeping all three moving together is the harder task.

chapters.title: Steady ground
chapters.text: For fifteen rounds running, strain stays at a stable level. The region is no longer just reacting to events, and the staff have room to plan, train and look after each other.

chapters.title: More than it cost
chapters.text: What the newly integrated residents contribute now comes back to the region at well over twice what the services cost to run. The money matters, though the office is quick to say that it was never the only reason for doing the work.

chapters.title: Thriving
chapters.text: The region's wellbeing has reached a level the early planners barely dared to sketch. Long-standing residents and newcomers now share schools, shops and street festivals.

chapters.title: Looking further ahead
chapters.text: The team opens the long-horizon outlook and looks past the next few rounds for the first time. The projection is only a projection, and the honest answer is that what happens depends on the choices still to be made.

chapters.title: A lasting transition
chapters.text: Forty rounds in, the region is still doing well, and it has held that level through changes in demand and in staff. What was once an emergency response has become a settled part of how the community works.

chapters.title: A model region
chapters.text: The region reaches a wellbeing level that other regions come to study, and the office is happy to share what it learned, including the mistakes. Everything here was built by people who kept showing up, and the newcomers now help welcome the next arrivals.
